name.text: Calculating the area of a given 8-sided figure

questiontext.text:
A regular octagon has center O. If the distance from the center to a vertex is OA = {@r@} cm, find the total area of the octagon.

Give your answer correct to 2 decimal places.

[[jsxgraph width="400px" height="400px"]] var R_val = {#r#}; var n = 8; // Proportional scaling for a 1:1 canvas var spanX = R_val * 2.5; var spanY = spanX; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID, { boundingbox: [-spanX/2, spanY/2, spanX/2, -spanY/2], maxboundingbox: [-spanX*1.5, spanY*1.5, spanX*1.5, -spanY*1.5], axis: false, showNavigation: false, showCopyright: false, keepAspectRatio: true }); /* Create Vertices */ var points = []; for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var angle = (2 * Math.PI * i / n); points.push(board.create('point', [R_val * Math.cos(angle), R_val * Math.sin(angle)], {visible: false})); } /* Create Octagon */ board.create('polygon', points, { fillColor: '#f5f5f5', borders: {strokeWidth: 2, strokeColor: '#424242'} }); var O = board.create('point', [0, 0], {name: 'O', color: '#212121', size: 3, label:{offset:[-15,-10]}}); var A = points[0]; var B = points[1]; /* Show the triangle slice */ board.create('segment', [O, A], {dash: 2, strokeColor: '#1976d2'}); board.create('segment', [O, B], {dash: 2, strokeColor: '#1976d2'}); /* Dynamic Midpoints for Labels */ var midA = board.create('midpoint', [O, A], {visible: false}); var midB = board.create('midpoint', [O, B], {visible: false}); var gapY = spanY * 0.03; /* Securely Anchored Labels */ board.create('text', [midA.X(), midA.Y() - gapY, R_val + " cm"], {anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'top', fontSize: 14}); board.create('text', [midB.X() - gapY, midB.Y() + gapY, R_val + " cm"], {anchorX: 'right', anchorY: 'bottom', fontSize: 14}); /* Angle Arc */ var arc_rad = R_val * 0.25; board.create('angle', [A, O, B], {radius: arc_rad, name: "45°", strokeColor: '#1976d2', fillColor: '#bbdefb'}); [[/jsxgraph]]

Area = [[input:ans1]] \(\text{cm}^2\) [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

A regular octagon is composed of 8 congruent isosceles triangles meeting at the centre O.

Step 1: Identify the properties of one triangle (\(\triangle AOB\))

  • The two equal sides (radii) are \(r = {@r@}\text{ cm}\).
  • The central angle is calculated as \(360^\circ \div 8 = 45^\circ\).

Step 2: Calculate the area of one triangle

Using the sine rule for the area of a triangle (\(\text{Area} = \frac{1}{2}ab\sin C\)):

\[ \begin{aligned} \text{Area of } \triangle AOB &= \frac{1}{2} \times {@r@} \times {@r@} \times \sin(45^\circ) \\ &= \frac{1}{2} \times {@r^2@} \times \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \\ &\approx {@disp_tri@} \text{ cm}^2 \end{aligned} \]

Step 3: Calculate the total area of the octagon

Since there are 8 such triangles in the octagon:

\[ \begin{aligned} \text{Total Area} &= 8 \times \text{Area of } \triangle AOB \\ &= 8 \times {@disp_tri@} \\ &= {@disp_ta@} \text{ cm}^2 \end{aligned} \]

prtpartiallycorrect.text: Your answer is partially correct.

prtincorrect.text: Incorrect answer.

truefeedback.text: You forgot the \(\frac{1}{2}\) factor. The area of a triangle using the sine rule is \(\frac{1}{2}ab\sin C\).
Almost there! You successfully calculated the area of exactly one of the inner triangles. Because it is a regular octagon, you must multiply this area by 8.
You multiplied the two sides together, but you forgot to include the sine of the angle between them. The formula is \(\frac{1}{2}ab\sin C\).
